name: Yellow-Purple Style
description: The hem of the white jacket is accented with a comic-style grid pattern, and a smug-looking little raccoon is featured on the inner outfit with a yellow-to-purple gradient. Wear this outfit, and you'll feel like the main character of a comic wherever you go.
story: "Trailblazer, which planet's fashion trend is this?"

source.description: Obtained from the "Claim Your Parcel" event
